protocol.signal_timing: observed trading-day close; fill at next available trading-day open
protocol.monthly_timing: first trading session of the month, detected from the preceding calendar session
protocol.momentum_unit: 244 observed trading bars per year; 61/122/244 for multi-horizon
protocol.momentum_gate: strictly positive mean cumulative return; all requested horizons required
protocol.missing_cash: retain any selected risk weights; unassigned residual stays uninvested cash
protocol.unavailable_asset: ineligible until all lookbacks and the current-day bar are available
protocol.monthly_between_rebalances: return None; preserve units, with no daily equal-weight reset
protocol.monthly_start_between_rebalances: wait until the next month; no special entry on a mid-month run start
